'''''Ranunculus gramineus''''', called the '''grass-leaved buttercup''', is a species of flowering plant in the genus ''[[Ranunculus]]'', native to the western Mediterranean; [[Morocco]], [[Algeria]], [[Tunisia]], [[Portugal]], [[Spain]], [[France]], [[Italy]] (including [[Sardinia]]), and [[Switzerland]].<ref name="712828-1" >{{cite web |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:712828-1 |title=''Ranunculus gramineus'' L. |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=17 March 2021 }}</ref> It has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web |title=''Ranunculus gramineus'' grass-leaved buttercup |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/14358/Ranunculus-gramineus/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=17 March 2021 |quote=Other common names; … grass-leaved crowfoot }}</ref>
